title: Approve the compositional option
question: Select your preferred layout composition for the Jet-Age Ticket Ledger interface.

options.label: Option 1: The Flight Ledger Stub
options.thesis: Single full-bleed boarding ledger with official rate table, validation stamp marks, and integrated currency conversion stub on the right rail.
options.viewport: Full-bleed ticket ledger with high-density tabular rate chart and side-by-side tear-off converter cards.
options.risk: Dense tabular view requires clear visual anchors to guide the primary calculation workflow.

options.label: Option 2: The Multi-Coupon Tabbed Booklet
options.thesis: Horizontal ticket wallet with perforated tear-off top tabs for each tool (Revalue Amount, USD Converter, Compare Prices, History Explorer).
options.viewport: Tabbed ticket wallet with distinct coupon tabs at top, active coupon expanding into an ultra-structured calculation matrix.
options.risk: Focuses heavily on one active workflow coupon at a time.

options.label: Option 3: Flight Manifest & Routing Deck
options.thesis: Prominent flight trajectory 75-year exchange rate history chart at top with modular tear-away boarding pass cards below for quick conversion and purchasing power.
options.viewport: Large 75-year historical route trajectory graph anchored above, with modular conversion and revaluation ticket cards below.
options.risk: Splits attention between historical chart and active converter.
